title: Ephemeral tenant shelf and circuit epoch guard
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: During a production incident last week we observed tenant recovery flapping when nodes with partially-drained KV caches rejoined. That flapping caused rapid circuit reopen/close cycles and triggered SLO alerts for the affected region. This PR introduces two coordinated features: 1) an ephemeral tenant-shelf that temporarily places low-priority tenant requests into a short-lived queue while the system heals, and 2) a circuit-epoch guard which binds circuit state transitions to epoch windows to prevent rapid reopen oscillations. The design aims to reduce cascade reopens, smooth SLO enforcement during regional rejoin events, and provide clear telemetry for postmortem analysis. Summary of changes: - New TenantShelf component in serving/runtime to accept and hold low-priority requests with configurable shelf TTL and max depth. - EpochGuard added to circuit-breaker state machine: transitions require an epoch stamp and minimum quiesce interval; stale epochs are rejected with clear metrics. - A new policy config (shelf.policy) to tie tenant weight, priority, and eligibility for shelving. - Graceful rollout: default disabled; enabled via runtime flag and guarded feature gate for canary. - Backward compatibility: shelf is permissive and falls back to existing behaviour if disabled. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (link: Linear ENG-4821) - [x] Unit tests for TenantShelf and EpochGuard state transitions - [x] Integration test with regional rejoin simulation - [x] Load test at 2x typical tenant burst - [x] Observability added (metrics and traces) Related work: references ENG-4803 (kv-drain coordination), ENG-4785 (tenant prioritizer). Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature gate, enable on canary region for 24h, monitor slo.delta and circuit.flip_rate for 6h, expand to other regions if stable. If regression observed, feature gate can be toggled off and a fast rollback will be performed. Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the TenantShelf in-memory for this iteration to simplify rollback; a follow-up will persist shelf metadata to avoid lost-in-flight telemetry during long drains.

review_comments: Diego Morales (2026-02-10): Design looks sound. Two asks: make shelf TTL configurable per-tenant and ensure we don't deadlock on shelf drain paths.
Priya Kapoor (2026-02-10): Addressed both items; added per-tenant override and reworked drain path to use non-blocking TTL timers.
Ava Chen (2026-02-11): Please add a metric for 'shelf_rejects_when_full' and add a short-circuit in the epoch guard to avoid retries from the same node.
Priya Kapoor (2026-02-11): Added metric and node-scoped short-circuit; updated tests to cover it.
Liam O'Connor (2026-02-12): Approved after CI green and a quick run in staging replicating rejoin pattern.
merge_outcome: Squash and merge. PR merged by Priya Kapoor after approvals and green CI. Feature gated off by default.
release_notes: Added an ephemeral tenant shelving mechanism to smooth low-priority request handling during regional recoveries and an epoch-based guard to prevent rapid circuit reopen/close oscillations. Feature off by default; enable via shelf.policy and feature gate for canary testing.
post_merge_actions: 1) Enable feature gate on canary region via infra/feature_gates (toggle: tenant_shelf=true) 2) Run synthetic rejoin test and monitor metrics: slo.delta, circuit.flip_rate, shelf_surge_count, shelf_rejects_when_full 3) If stable for 24h, follow staged rollout to other regions as per rollout plan in description.
testing_notes: Integration scenario included a simulated regional drain and rejoin that previously caused >200 circuit flips/min; with this change flips were reduced to <10/min and slo.delta decreased by ~35% in the canary run. Load test at 2x burst showed shelf saturation behavior and correct reject metric emission. All unit tests and integration tests are included in the CI run.
changelog_entry: runtime: introduce ephemeral tenant shelf and circuit epoch guard (opt-in behind feature gate).
audit_trail: PR opened by Priya Kapoor; reviewers Diego Morales, Ava Chen, Liam O'Connor; CI green; merged 2026-02-12. Related Linear tasks ENG-4821, ENG-4829.
notes_for_oncall: If SLO regressions occur after enabling on a region, immediately disable feature gate 'tenant_shelf' and watch for 'shelf_rejects_when_full' and 'circuit_epoch_rejects'. If shelf_rejects_when_full is high, consider increasing shelf.capacity or lowering shelf.policy eligibility thresholds.
follow_up: Persist shelf metadata (ENG-4970), add cross-zone shelf draining to preserve KV cache locality (ENG-4983), and implement persistent retry queue for long drains.
